name: Cognor Holding S.A.
summary: Cognor Holding S.A. produces and distributes steel products. The company offers flat plates and bars, slabs, round and square bars, reinforcing bars, T-profiles, equal and unequal side angles, billets with rounded edger for forgings, metal sheets, carbon and medium-alloy steels, and high-alloy and special steels, as well as products from non-ferrous metals and non-ferrous metal scrap. It also engages in the purchasing, processing, treatment, and sale of steel scrap; and processing of steel scrap into billets, as well as billets into steel products. The company operates in Poland, Germany, Switzerland, Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia, Italy, the Great Britain, Austria, Lithuania, France, and internationally. It also exports its products primarily to Germany and other European countries. The company was formerly known as Cognor S A and changed its name to Cognor Holding S.A. in November 2016. Cognor Holding S.A. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Poraj, Poland. Cognor Holding S.A. is a subsidiary of PS HoldCo Sp. z o.o.
